claims: Artemis II is estimated to cost over $4 billion per launch.
The cost of Artemis II covers the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and the Orion crew capsule.
Total expenses for the entire Artemis campaign are expected to exceed $90 billion to $100 billion by 2025.
The per-launch cost for Artemis II is approximately $4.1 to $4.2 billion.
The Orion crew capsule alone is projected to cost $9.3 billion through the second flight, including development and hardware.
The Artemis program is primarily funded by U.S. taxpayers, with additional support from international partners.
The total Artemis program through 2025 is estimated to cost around $93 billion.
High costs for the expendable SLS rocket have led NASA to increasingly incorporate commercial systems such as SpaceX's Starship and Blue Origin's New Glenn for future missions.
